name: USB-C to Lightning Charging Cable 1m
description:
USB-C adapter ke saath compatible Lightning-port devices ko charge karne ke liye cable. Iska 1-meter length daily charging aur data transfer ke liye convenient hai, agar cable data transfer support karti ho.
Key Features:
1-meter length
USB-C to Lightning connector
Compatible devices ke liye charging
Ghar aur office ke liye suitable
